workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic SHA-256 verification of the authoritative generated Analysis prompt, complete reading of all seven required control/editorial/evidence sources, a durable same-date Wake Receipt, repository-granted global-serial execution authority and a verified Worker Claimed event. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-19 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260819-01 concludes that delegated roles should be modeled as monotonic authority deltas under an inherited maximum authority envelope: behavioral specialization and bounded capability reduction may vary while parent-owned authority-bearing configuration remains inherited, including across resume; this does not prove complete delegation security or runtime effect containment. Q-20260819-02 concludes that user-visible delivery and model reasoning context should be separate but correlated durable planes: local item acceptance/emission may be acknowledged without echoing visible text into future model context, while external delivery, acknowledgement, retry and effect certainty require separate evidence. Q-20260819-03 concludes that successful remote OAuth refresh followed by local persistence failure is a split-commit partial-success state, not an ordinary refresh failure; fail-visible propagation preserves the evidence needed for recovery but does not create rollback or distributed transactionality. No prior-day research input, article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was used or performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 在完成 Fail-closed Admission、权威 Generated Analysis Prompt 的 SHA-256 确定性核验、全部 7 个 Required Control/Editorial/Evidence Source 的完整读取、同日 Wake Receipt 持久核验、仓库授予的全局串行执行权与 Worker Claimed 核验后，仅执行 Skill 04 Research Analysis。只消费 2026-08-19 当日三份已完成 Reading Result，并恰好形成三份 Research Object。Q-20260819-01 的判断是：委派 Role 应被建模为继承最大 Authority Envelope 之下的单调 Authority Delta；行为专业化与有界 Capability Reduction 可以变化，而 Parent 持有的 Authority-bearing 配置继续继承，并在 Resume 后保持同一性质；这不证明完整委派安全或运行时 Effect Containment。Q-20260819-02 的判断是：用户可见 Delivery 与 Model Reasoning Context 应成为分离但相关联的持久 Plane；Runtime 可以确认本地 Item Acceptance/Emission 而不把可见文本回灌到未来 Model Context，但 External Delivery、Acknowledgement、Retry 与 Effect Certainty 需要独立证据。Q-20260819-03 的判断是：远端 OAuth Refresh 成功后本地 Persistence Failure 属于 Split-commit Partial-success State，而不是普通 Refresh Failure；Fail-visible Propagation 保留安全 Recovery 所需证据，但不会产生 Rollback 或 Distributed Transactionality。未复用前一日研究输入，也未执行文章撰写、可视化、Publication Candidate 创建或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: Delegated agent roles should be monotonic authority deltas under an inherited maximum authority envelope: they may specialize an explicitly declared behavioral subset and reduce bounded capabilities, while authority-bearing routing, permission and infrastructure configuration remains inherited; resume and reconstruction must re-establish the same envelope before applying the delta.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 委派 Agent Role 应是继承最大 Authority Envelope 之下的单调 Authority Delta：可以专业化显式声明的行为子集并收缩有界能力，而 Authority-bearing 的 Routing、Permission 与 Infrastructure Configuration 继续继承；Resume 与重建必须先重新建立同一 Envelope，再应用 Delta。

researchObjects.judgment: Long-running agents should separate the user-delivery plane from the model reasoning-context plane while correlating both through stable message identity and replayable metadata; local acceptance/emission is not external delivery evidence, and context-excluded facts should enter future reasoning only through an explicit memory or workflow-state mechanism when needed.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 长时间运行的 Agent 应把 User-delivery Plane 与 Model Reasoning-context Plane 分离，同时用稳定 Message Identity 与可回放 Metadata 关联二者；Local Acceptance/Emission 不是 External Delivery Evidence，而被排除在 Context 之外的事实只有在确有需要时，才应通过显式 Memory 或 Workflow-state Mechanism 进入后续推理。

researchObjects.judgment: OAuth refresh should be modeled as a split-commit workflow when remote credential issuance and local durable persistence are separate; after remote success, local persistence failure is a distinct partial-success state that must remain visible for reconciliation rather than being silently reclassified as an ordinary refresh failure or redirect.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 当远端 Credential Issuance 与本地 Durable Persistence 分离时，OAuth Refresh 应被建模为 Split-commit Workflow；远端成功以后，本地 Persistence Failure 是独立 Partial-success State，必须保持可见以便 Reconciliation，而不能静默重分类为普通 Refresh Failure 或 Redirect。
